texts: On day 17 of Year 1, the eleven relit lanterns of the Middle Row burned dimly.
The dim lanterns gave weak mist-light.
The weak mist-light attracted a handful of nightmoths.
The moth-count at the Middle Row was twelve that night.
The thread harvest at the Middle Row fell.
Pell and Coraline Ash collected few silken threads from the Middle Row the next morning.
Hesper boiled the silken threads in sea-water at Cauldron Hall that day.
The cauldrons yielded two vessels of mire-essence instead of three.

q1_issues.issue: (LocatedIn sk_cauldron_1 cauldron_hall) asserts a location the text never states — nothing places the cauldrons in Cauldron Hall, and an obvious world relation is not an atom.
A strength-0 Measure is derived from "instead of three", but strength 0.0 is licensed only by an explicit not / n't / no / never.
Measure's scale slot is filled with the invented symbol `quantity` although no dimension word is stated; an unstated scale takes the reserved `unspecified` (same in statement 87).
"that night" hangs Time / Day / Year atoms directly on the entity witness sk_moth_count_1 (statements 32-34) rather than on an eventuality, while the tense sits only on the Measure at 35.

q2_gaps: "instead of N" — a corrective/substitutive numeral contrasting the actual value with an expected one
a container/measure partitive ("two vessels of mire-essence"): excluded from the genitive rules as a measure, but given no positive encoding

a copular clause whose predicate is a bare numeral/measure and which carries a time modifier — the time-modifier trigger prescribes reifying an adjectival state, but a numeric predication supplies no state symbol to anchor Time on
bare "few" (not "a few") quantifying an episodic object — the quantifier table routes "few" to the strength channel (generic / partitive), while CardinalityPhrase's vague-count list has only "a few"

tense on a prenominal adjectival modifier inside a past-tense verbal clause ("the relit lanterns burned") — the wrapping rule covers copular clauses and appositives, not prenominal modifiers, so the distributed property atoms at 5 and 13 are unwrapped by default
review.notes: Group/distribution handling, the compound decompositions (mist_light, nightmoth, silken_thread), and the "that night" / "the next morning" term propagation are all correct. The defects cluster in the last sentence, where an unstated containment and an unlicensed strength-0 twin are emitted.

issues.reason: No word places the cauldrons anywhere — Core patterns bars exactly this ("no unstated property, possessor, location or causal link, however obvious"), and the only Cauldron Hall the text supplies is the Location of Hesper's boiling, so the containment atom is unstated content.

"only an explicit not / n't / no / never sets strength 0.0" is the lexical-antonym bar, not a global one (a prohibition emits (permitted V) at 0.0 and "too young to vote" emits a 0.0 event bundle, both with no negator), and in the uncovered "instead of N" territory the emitted atom is true — a two-vessel yield is not a three-vessel one.

Measures & units: "A scale no word supplies is never invented — an unstated dimension takes the reserved slot symbol `unspecified`"; "two vessels of mire-essence" states no dimension word, and `quantity` is licensed only in Degree's too-much / too-little / enough slot, never as a Measure scale.

Time says its atoms attach to "the event witness (or an event-denoting noun like 'the show')" and a moth-count is such a noun, the Past-wrapped Measure is the licensed tense form ("Alice was 6 feet tall" → (Past (Measure …))), and every emitted term is true of "that night" (Day 17, Year 1, night) — the reviewer's own q2 gap concedes a numeric predicate supplies no state symbol, which makes this a gap, not a defect.

gaps_confirmed: "instead of N" — a corrective/substitutive numeral: nothing carries the expected-versus-actual contrast, so the expectation of three vessels is simply lost

a container/measure of-phrase ("two vessels of mire-essence") — explicitly excluded from the genitive rules as a measure but given no positive routing; Measure with an `unspecified` scale is the near-fit the instruction set never states
a copular clause whose predicate is a bare numeral/measure and which carries a time modifier — the reification trigger yields no state symbol for Time to anchor on
bare "few" (not "a few") on an episodic count object — the quantifier table routes "few" to the strength channel and the vague-count lexicon lists only "a few", so neither channel clearly owns it

tense on a prenominal participial/adjectival modifier in a past-tense verbal clause ("the relit lanterns burned") — the wrapping rule reaches copular clauses and appositives only, so the distributed property atoms stand untensed
new_gaps: a locative PP on an abstract measurement/tally noun ("the moth-count at the Middle Row") — "at" forces LocatedIn under the containment-only rule, which asserts spatial containment of a count, while Location is barred on an entity; the station-scoping the text states has no licensed head
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: the compliant form emits the cauldron group and its yield event with no location atom at all, since the text locates only the boiling at Cauldron Hall. Issue 2: the compliant form is (Measure sk_essence_1 unspecified 2 vessel) — the reserved `unspecified` in the scale slot, exactly as the parse itself uses it in the moth-count measure's unit slot — and the same substitution in the strength-0 twin.
adjudication.notes: The passage's harder machinery is handled correctly: the group plus per-member distribution rules, every compound decomposition (mist_light, nightmoth, silken_thread, thread_harvest, sea_water, mire_essence) with noun modifiers suppressed and the material adjective `silken` exposed, and the "that night" / "the next morning" / "that day" term propagation with its Before link. Both confirmed defects sit in the final sentence and both have licensed compliant forms, so no fix-blocking gap arises from them.
